source: GoogleTrendArchive: Google Trends 'Trending Now' national feeds for 125 countries, collected every 10 minutes, Nov. 27, 2024 to May 17, 2026. Topics merged by the world-attention pipeline.
note: One row per UTC day of the archive. events = scheduled events (appointments) that trended in 15+ countries within an hour that day; each event counts once, on the day of its scheduled start (else of its first moment). widest = the event with the largest event reach (countries where any topic about it trended in its window). no_football / no_sport = the same without football, without any sport. searches = up to 3 real searches of the widest event, as typed. gap = collection gap day (lower counts). weekday: 0 = Monday. Summary statistics use the full-coverage days only.
takeaway: On 481 of 486 days, at least one scheduled event trended in 15 or more countries.
